description: Simpler shader task. Tests spatial reasoning and the absence of time dependence.
prompt: Write a GLSL ES 3.0 fragment shader in shader.glsl implementing mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord). Uniforms iResolution (vec3) and iTime (float) are provided; do not redeclare them and do not write a main() function. Requirements: (1) brightness must increase from left to right across the frame; (2) the result must be predominantly red; (3) the output must NOT change when iTime changes; (4) no NaN or fully black output.
